body:
cmdUseItem checks ownership, looks the item up via itemdefReg, rejects non-consumables by name, honestly reports nothing-happens-yet for a real consumable. No state mutation yet -- proves the command path end-to-end before Phase 1's mod-hook dispatch has anything to attach to. Live, end-to-end verified against a real throwaway apps2/mud instance + a real IDUNA test character (bought a real Hi-Potion, used it, confirmed message; confirmed ownership-check rejects an empty inventory). Found and flagged two real, pre-existing, separate bugs: itemdef.Registry.ByName keys don't match the shop's own hyphenated item-ID convention for multi-word items, and the existing eat command misreads args[1] instead of args[0]. Commit cbda9c8.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD item builder Phase 0: real use-item command shipped
